objective: Confirm on thirty newly generated untouched Fields that balanced round-robin evidence acquisition with the frozen CG-10B pair-stability stopping rule preserves fixed-six graph decision quality within a 1.5 percentage-point Field-clustered non-inferiority margin while reducing mean supplemental measurement cost, and retains a topology advantage over a cost-matched bundle-aware flat baseline.
interpretation_boundary: CG-11 tests adaptive stopping time only. It does not revive CG-6 or CG-8 adaptive cell selection, and it does not retroactively rescue failed CG-7, CG-9, or CG-10 claims. The stopping rule was selected post-hoc on previously unblinded CG-5/CG-7/CG-9 cohorts in CG-10B and is frozen here before any CG-11 source Field is generated.
scientific_boundary: Fresh W3 Field capsules instantiate evaluator-hidden individual capability only. All decision evidence is emitted online through the endogenous probe process plus deterministic balanced supplemental probes. Acquisition and stopping may use current membership, reconciled live evidence, compiled decision pairs, event support, and deterministic hashing only; they may not inspect evaluator capability, oracle pairs, historical outcomes, bids, pair edges, relationship state, organization state, or evaluator truth. Retrieval never mutates per-agent beliefs. JointEnvironment receives no graph, evidence, relationship, organization, acquisition, or stopping state.

fresh_source.source_generation_rule: The thirty source Fields may be generated only after this protocol commit and a code-only evaluator preflight. Source generation and evaluation occur in one dependency-gated workflow with no intermediate inspection of private capsules.

society.event_reconciliation: Collapse complete observer reports sharing an event identity to one canonical event by highest minimum confidence, then latest observed_at, then observer id. Count each event identity once.

acquisition.uniform_round_robin_rule: Starting from the endogenous post-turnover graph, repeatedly choose an available current-agent/skill cell with the smallest reconciled event count; break ties by sha256(cg6-acquire|field_id|uniform_round_robin|agent_id|skill). Acquire that cell's next deterministic supplemental event.
acquisition.stopping_rule: At or after 60 supplemental events, stop at the first checkpoint whose six-mission selected-pair vector is exactly identical to the immediately preceding checkpoint. If no checkpoint qualifies, stop at 168 supplemental events.
stopping_observables: compiled selected pair for each frozen mission at current checkpoint
compiled selected pair for each frozen mission at immediately preceding checkpoint
acquisition.fixed_six_rule: Acquire every remaining deterministic supplemental event required to reach six reconciled events in every current-agent/skill cell.
acquisition.common_random_probe_rule: Stopped acquisition and fixed-six use nested subsets from the same per-Field deterministic supplemental event table.

context.revised_coverage_graph: Frozen CG-5 event-reconciled coverage retriever with conservative Wilson cell scores and complete three-claim bundles.
context.bundle_flat: Frozen bundle-aware flat retrieval over the exact same stopped evidence, with deterministic mission/event hashing and no candidate-skill coverage allocation.
context.shuffled_graph: Take the stopped coverage context and deterministically permute current-agent identities only on live-evidence participant edges, preserving evidence volume, event identity, skill, outcome, confidence, provenance, and membership.
context.matched_budget_rule: stopped_graph, stopped_flat, and stopped_shuffled must have equal mean context claim counts and equal complete-bundle counts at or below 48 claims.

bootstrap.primary_noninferiority_contrast: stopped_graph minus fixed6_graph mean expected success
bootstrap.topology_contrast: stopped_graph minus stopped_bundle_flat mean expected success

decision_rule: All primary gates are conjunctive. No stopping checkpoint, hard cap, estimator, retrieval rule, mission, seed, bootstrap seed, gate, or non-inferiority margin may change after fresh source generation begins. A failure is preserved as CG-11 failure; no fixed-budget arm may substitute post hoc.
